newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends week lower.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends week lower.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower on Friday after buyers remained sidelined for most of the week, entering the market to only nibble at selected products, dealers said.

At Friday's close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS 1 at 279.50 cents ($1.11) a kg, down two cents from Thursday. May SMR 20 buyer also ended two cents lower at 265.50.
On a weekly basis, the RSS1 fell 10 cents and the SMR 20 seven cents.
On Friday, trading houses offered the SMR 20 at 262 cents a kg, SMR CV at 332, SMR L at 312, SMR 5 at 273, SMR 10 at 260 and drum latex FOB at 228.
Traders said they expected a further fall next week. "There's nothing on the horizon I see that is going to pull the market out of its present state," said a dealer.

The INRO five-day moving indicator was quoted at 212.41 Malaysian/Singaporean cents per kg on April 24, compared to the 213.89 on April 23. The daily indicator also ended lower at 209.44 from 210.37 previously.
